title: Knots–Quivers Correspondence for All Knots
exact_target: Determine whether every knot has a quiver whose motivic series reproduces all its colored HOMFLY--PT invariants.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30005247 (OWR-11695854-003). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mini-Workshop: Quantization of Complex Symplectic Varieties (2022), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2022/45, pp. 2629--2658. Original report and mathematical context.

status_qualification: The substitutions and framing conventions are part of the correspondence. Equality of one uncolored polynomial would not establish the stated all-color generating-series claim.
